name: How do weekends and holidays affect 1031 exchange deadlines?

mainEntity.name: How do weekends and holidays affect 1031 exchange deadlines?

acceptedAnswer.text: The 45-day identification period and the 180-day exchange period for a 1031 exchange include weekends and holidays. There are no automatic extensions for deadlines falling on non-business days. This means that if your 45th or 180th day falls on a Saturday, Sunday, or federal holiday, that is still your deadline. Careful planning and working with an experienced real estate professional are essential to ensure all actions are taken on time. Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution helps clients in South Florida navigate these precise timelines.
